_comment: Words the D'ni language actually attests, in the typeface's encoding. Everything absent here is
approximated by art/transliteration.json instead, so this table is free to stay small.
Sources, both fan compilations of Richard A. Watson's language for Cyan's Myst: the D'ni Lexicon
(eldalamberon.com/dni_dict.htm), and Larry W. Fontenot's fuller dictionary at
florestica.com/hpotd/dni_dictionary/dni.pdf, which attests 744 headwords. Both pair a romanisation
with its typeface spelling — e.g. delahn / Delan, 'sky' — and the second's headword form IS this
encoding, which its orthography table confirms glyph by glyph. See notes/dni-sources.md.
Two are derived rather than attested, an attested noun with the adjective suffix -ex:
